testCases.title: Empty cart displays empty message and link to home
Empty cart displays illustration or icon per FR-07 and FR-24
Adding 1 product from home displays correct name, quantity and subtotal
Adding 2 different products displays 2 rows and accurate total
Adding the same product twice merges into 1 row with quantity 2
Cart table headers match FR-07 specification
Quantity column provides +/- buttons to adjust item quantity
Clicking Delete prompts a confirmation dialog before removing item
Cart total label must be 'Tổng cộng' per FR-07
Continue shopping button must be labeled 'Tiếp tục mua sắm' and navigate home
Navbar Cart link displays item quantity badge per FR-23
Cart page includes navigation breadcrumb per FR-23
Product detail Add to Cart works on the first click
Unauthenticated user clicking Checkout is alerted and redirected to /login
